items.html: *And behold, it was already explained the matter of the three aspects that the fetus has in the secret of the Ibur. And there it was explained that the third aspect of them is his being a son of exactly nine Sefirot. And behold, now too, in the Yenika, he must also have nine Sefirot in him; and these are completed in him when he is a son of nine years and one day. And in these years he grows his limbs and corrects them, for they were already in him in the days of the Ibur; only now they grow and are corrected, until the completion of nine years and one day. And then, afterward, he will have Mochin fit to give birth. Therefore, from nine years and one day, his coition is a [valid] coition.
